Agony Hex: R60' Inflicts nauseated for 20 rd (save Fortitude DC 21 negates; additional saves each rd end) once per target per day
Cackle Hex: R30' Can use a move action to extend self Agony, Charm, Evil Eye, Fortune, and Misfortune hex effects for 1 rd
Catch Off-Guard: Using an improvised melee weapon inflicts no penalty and makes unarmed foes flat-footed
Charm Hex: R30' Can improve the attitude of a target animal or humanoid by 2 (save Will DC 21 negates) for 1 rd once per target per day
Coven Hex: R30' Can use Aid Another to give a target with the Coven hex +1 caster level for 1 rd
Death Curse Hex: R30' Target becomes fatigued (save Will DC 21 negates) for 1 rd, then exhausted for 1 rd, then dies (save Fortitude DC 21 inflicts 4d6+20 HP) once per target per day
Eternal Slumber Hex: Touch or a poison lasting 1 min inflicts permanent sleep (save Will DC 21 negates) once target per day
Evil Eye Hex: R30' Inflicts -4 on a choice of Armor Class, ability checks, attacks, saves, or skill checks for 4 rd (save Will DC 21 effects last for 1 rd)
Fortune Hex: R30' Allows a target to take the better of 2 rolls on an ability check, attack, save, or skill check once per rd for 3 rd once per target per day
Lunge: Can suffer -2 Armor Class until the start of the next turn to gain +5' melee range until the end of the turn
Misfortune Hex: R30' Forces a target to take the worse of 2 rolls on ability checks, attacks, saves, and skill checks (save Will DC 21 negates) for 3 rd once per target per day
Retribution Hex: R60' Target suffers half as much damage as it inflicts (save Will DC 21 negates) for 1 rd
Vital Strike: Can use an attack action to make a single attack that inflicts 2x base damage
Ward Hex: Gives the target +4 Armor Class and saves until it fails a save or a foe hits it; can have only one Ward hex active at a time

Animal Shapes (Witch8 Tran): R75' Transforms 20 willing targets in a 15' radius into a chosen Diminutive - Huge animal or a Small - Medium magical beast for 20 hr

Cat's Grace (Witch2 Tran): Gives touched +4 Dexterity (save Will DC 13 negates) for 20 min
Comprehend Languages (Tongues Hex1 Divi): Allows self to understand written text and words spoken in any language for 200 min
Control Weather (Weather Control Hex7 Tran): Modifies seasonal weather within a 2 mile radius for 4d12 hr
Cure Critical Wounds (Major Healing Hex4 Conj): Touched regains 4d8+20 hit points (save Will DC 15 negates); undead instead suffer the same amount (save Will DC 15 half)
Cure Light Wounds (Healing Hex1 Conj): Touched regains 1d8+5 hit points (save Will DC 12 negates); undead instead suffer the same amount (save Will DC 12 half)
Cure Moderate Wounds (Healing Hex2 Conj): Touched regains 2d8+10 hit points (save Will DC 13 negates); undead instead suffer the same amount (save Will DC 13 half)
Cure Serious Wounds (Major Healing Hex3 Conj): Touched regains 3d8+15 hit points (save Will DC 14 negates); undead instead suffer the same amount (save Will DC 14 half)
Disguise Self (Disguise Hex1 Illu): Changes the appearance of self (save Will DC 12 upon interaction disbelieves) and gives +10 Disguise, for 200 min
Earthquake (Natural Disaster Hex8 Evoc): R1200' Causes an intense tremor to shake an 80' radius for 1 rd, prohibiting movement, breaking spell concentration (DC 20 + spell level concentration negates), collapsing caverns, cliffs, and structures that inflict 8d6 HP (save Reflex DC 15 half) and pin creatures in the rubble, knocking down creatures on open ground (save Reflex DC 15 negates) and opening fissures with a 25% chance to fall in (save Reflex DC 20 negates); pinned creatures suffer 1d6 HP nonlethal each min until unconscious, then 1d6 HP lethal each min (save Constitution DC 15 negates)
Ethereal Jaunt (Witch7 Tran): Makes self ethereal for 20 rd
Feather Fall (Flight Hex1 Tran): R75' Slows 20 falling targets in a 10' radius to 60' per rd (save Will DC 12 negates) for 20 rd
Fly (Flight Hex3 Tran): Gives touched a 60' fly Speed with good maneuverability and +10 Fly skill (save Will DC 14 negates) for 20 min, after which it floats downward 60' per rd for 1d6 rd
Freedom Of Movement (Witch4 Abju): Allows touched to ignore movement impediments, escape grapples, and move normally when underwater, (save Will DC 15 negates) for 200 min
Haste (Witch3 Tran): R75' 20 targets in a 15' radius gain an extra attack at full BAB during a full-attack action, +1 attacks, a +1 dodge bonus to Armor Class, +1 Reflex saves, and +30 Speed (save Fortitude DC 14 negates) for 20 rd
Jump (Witch1 Tran): Gives touched +30 Acrobatics to jumps (save Will DC 12 negates) for 20 min
Levitate (Flight Hex2 Tran): R75' Allows using a move action each rd to raise or lower an unattended object or willing creature 20' each rd for 20 min
Mass Cat's Grace (Witch6 Tran): R75' 20 targets in a 15' radius gain +4 Dexterity (save Will DC 17 negates) for 20 min
Nightmare (Nightmares Hex5 Illu): Inflicts on a specified sleeping living target 1d10 HP, fatigue, and an inability to regain arcane spells for 24 hr (save Will DC 16 negates, modified from +10 to -10 depending on familiarity and connection with the target)
Polymorph (Witch5 Tran): Transforms the touched willing living target into a Tiny-Large animal, a Small elemental, or a Small-Medium humanoid (save Will DC 16 negates) for 20 min; the target can use a full-round action to end the spell
Reincarnate (Forced Reincarnation Hex5 Tran): Uses part of a corpse, dead up to 1 week, to restore a willing soul to full health in a generated young adult body of a random species
Resurrection (Life Giver Hex7 Conj): Fully restores a target willing soul, dead up to 200 years, using a piece of its corpse; the target gains a permanent negative level (level 1 targets instead suffer 2 points of Constitution drain)
Shapechange (Witch9 Tran): Allows self to become a humanoid, elemental, dragon, giant, or plant creature once per rd for 200 min
Sleep (Slumber Hex1 Ench): R300' Puts 4 HD of living creatures in a 10' radius to sleep (save Will DC 12 negates), moving upward from those with the lowest HD, for 20 min; shaking or wounding wakens an affected creature, but noise does not
Storm Of Vengeance (Natural Disaster Hex9 Conj): R1200' Creates a 360' radius storm that inflicts deafened for 1d4x10 min (save Fortitude DC 20 negates), then produces rain that inflicts 1d6 HP acid, then generates lightning bolts that inflict 10d6 HP electricity on 6 targets (save Reflex DC 20 half), then creates hail that inflicts 5d6 HP bludgeoning, then produces violent wind and rain that reduce Speed by 3/4 and obscure vision, giving a 20% miss chance on attacks within 5' and a 50% miss chance on more distant attacks, for 6 rd; the storm also prevents ranged attacks and disrupts spellcasting (save Concentration negates; add the level of the spell to be cast to the DC)
Tongues (Tongues Hex3 Divi): Allows touched to speak and understand any language (save Will DC 14 negates) for 200 min
